title: Driver Earnings Terms, Clause 11: Credits Still Settling on Younger Accounts
content:
**11.1** For the largest instant cashout under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, credits posted today may be held as settling. The settling credits follow how many whole months the earnings account has been open, counted from its opened date:

(a) an account open fewer than 3 whole months has every credit posted today held as settling;
(b) an account open at least 3 but fewer than 6 whole months has only the tips posted today held as settling;
(c) an account open 6 whole months or more has nothing held as settling.

**11.2** Credits held as settling are taken off the available balance first, before anything else in the largest instant cashout is worked out; the balance that remains is the settled balance.

**11.3** "Credits posted today" are the entries credited to the earnings account on the earnings statement dated today: trip pay, tips, the driver's shares of cancellation and no-show fees, cleaning and damage payouts, bonuses, and missing-pay credits.

## Clause 11.1 by account age

| Whole months open | Held as settling |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | Every credit posted today |
| 3 to 5 | Only the tips posted today |
| 6 or more | Nothing |

## Hypothetical day on the statement

Credits posted today: trip pay 64.20 and 38.10, a tip 9.00, a bonus 50.00. Available balance 400.00.

| Account open | Held as settling | Settled balance |
|---|---|---|
| 2 whole months | 161.30 (all credits today) | 238.70 |
| 3 whole months | 9.00 (the tip) | 391.00 |
| 5 whole months | 9.00 (the tip) | 391.00 |
| 6 whole months | 0.00 | 400.00 |
